title: 'Son of man' title taken from the Parables of Enoch

tellings.quote: The proper title the son of man comes from first Enoch specifically from the second section of first Enoch which is called the parables.

plain: The title "son of man" that Jesus of Nazareth uses for himself comes from the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text left out of most Bibles, says a researcher named Tim Alberino. He gives no source but points to its second section, called the Parables: "The proper title the son of man comes from first Enoch specifically from the second section of first Enoch which is called the parables." He also mentions the Book of Daniel. If he is right, it would tie Jesus's view of himself to Enoch's stories.
